Name: Milk Egg Combine Split
Author: hrmpk
Description:
The divine power of Yoba  allows the farmer to combine 2 regular milks or goat milks into large versions, or to split a large milk into 2 regular milks. Also splits large white/brown chicken eggs into 2 regular ones and vice versa. Retains type (goat/cow), color (white/brown) and quality(silver, gold, etc). 

With version 2.0, the Sign of the Vessel sold by Krobus now only unites things together, while the Grave Stone sold by Pierre on Spirit's Eve [i]decomposes [/i]them apart. 

Automate users:
This is a PFM mod. To automate PFM machines, install the PFM Automate patch by digus: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5038
